div.head: Grið 28
div.ab: Ac haligdom ⁊ hadas ⁊ gehalgode Godes hus a man sceal for Godes ege weorðian georne ⁊ inwerdre heortan æfre God lufian.
Ac haligdom and hadas and gehalgode Godes hus a man sceal for Godes ege weorðian georne, and inwerdre heortan æfre God lufian.
Vielmehr soll man Heiligthum und Geistliche und geweihte Gotteshäuser immer aus Gottesfurcht eifrig ehren und aus innerstem Herzen stets Gott lieben.
Rather, one must always eagerly honour the sanctuary and the clergy and consecrated houses of God out of fear of God, and always love God with one's inmost heart.
But holiness and the holy orders and the hallowed house of God shall always be fervently venerated for fear of God, and God always be loved with one’s innermost heart.
